causal_chain: observed Signal metadata rc2 -> suffix-based scanner branch on .raw -> SHA-guarded .apk read-only alias -> skip false metadata retry -> fresh metadata and four-phase receipts
challenged_assumption: APK byte identity alone is enough for scanner dispatch; falsified by same-content control/treatment.
direction: APK content identity versus filename suffix dispatch; distinct from EVO42 ABI and EVO43 SDK risk

discarded_action.action: Pass arbitrary downloaded .raw filename directly into scanner.apk_metadata as if content identity alone selected APK parsing.
discarded_action.causal_reason: scanner.py lines 893-903 dispatch by suffix before parsing and falls back to stem as package.
discarded_action.observed_failure: metadata rc2, manifest_available false; DEX and ELF not run.

inferences: This suffix mismatch caused Signal v1 metadata failure.
An alias with content guard may remove this class of false stop for exact APK inputs.
observations: Four source receipts above exist and were SHA-pinned for this reflection.

one_improvement.candidate: Before invoking apk_metadata on an accepted exact APK, provide a project-owned read-only .apk-named alias to the same validated bytes; preserve original raw path and SHA in receipts.
one_improvement.failure_behavior: Fail closed before metadata; leave old raw and v1 failure immutable; no count change.
one_improvement.invalidation: Reject when raw SHA, scanner SHA, target path, alias target, or expected package/version changes; never reuse a prior failed generation receipt.
one_improvement.key: expected raw SHA256 + scanner.py SHA256 + alias suffix .apk + canonical target path
one_improvement.mechanism: Selects scanner APK parse branch while preserving content identity; removes a false metadata wall caused solely by transport filename.
one_improvement.pilot_result: Same Signal SHA and byte count: body.raw manifest_available false/package body; .apk symlink manifest_available true/package org.thoughtcrime.securesms/version 8.29.3/code 175901/targetSdk36. Metadata call pair 1.51s.
one_improvement.promotion_gate: In a fresh immutable static generation, pin raw+scanner+alias-target SHA, run metadata-only preflight and independent review, then four phases; admit only exact matching package/version and all four rc0. Keep v1 terminal and counts unchanged until then.
one_improvement.risk: A mutable symlink target or extension camouflage could create mismatched provenance; content SHA and target identity must be checked before and after parse.
one_improvement.scope: Host-only APK static metadata for exact accepted APK; does not prove installation, Bionic bridge, cold start, or 89-tool PASS.

pilot_setup_note: First invocation with system Python lacked androguard; rerun used existing harness venv; no scanner code or source APK edit.
problem: Official Signal content was accepted raw but host four-phase v1 stopped at metadata rc2 before DEX/ELF; scanner returned package body and manifest_available false for body.raw.
repeated_cost: A valid APK can be downloaded with a transport filename that has no .apk suffix, causing avoidable metadata stop and another scanner generation. G324 Signal v1 is the observed case; prevalence across portfolio is unknown.
unknowns: Whether a fresh Signal four-phase generation will pass.
Whether other raw APKs have the same filename-driven failure.
